name: Make Texture Tileable
description: Z-Image-Turbo. Makes a texture repeat with no visible edge. The picture is shifted by half, then the lines in the middle are repainted. The size stays the same.
promptGuide: This preset has no prompt. It only needs a start image of a surface, for example floor, wall, metal or grass. It works best when the texture has even light, with no spotlight or dark corners.
